primary_outcome.name: PRIMARY_DISTRESS
primary_outcome.definition: Severe credit or insolvency distress within H=12 months after as_of: any one of IBBI_CIRP_ADMISSION or RATING_DOWNGRADE_D, event date = the earliest trustworthy known_at.

SEVERE_DRAWDOWN.definition: 12-month trailing return at least X percentage points below the cross-sectional median return across the EQ-series universe that month.
SEVERE_DRAWDOWN.threshold_basis: p5 of the real, pooled, ETF-filtered, winsorized empirical excess-return distribution, 2016-01 to 2026-10, 117 usable months, 149,285 observations -- see docs/modelling/outcomes.md and docs/phase-3/evidence/drawdown-threshold-run2-filtered.log
SEVERE_DRAWDOWN.etf_filter: symbol-pattern heuristic (ETF/BEES/GOLDSHARE/LIQUID/GOLD/SILVER substrings), disclosed as imperfect

SEBI_ORDER_AGAINST_COMPANY.definition: A real SEBI final or interim order exists, auto-linked to the company (or its promoters, not distinguished further).

BHAVCOPY_DISAPPEARANCE.definition: No EQ-series trade for at least min_gap_days before the end of this project's bhavcopy coverage, with no later re-appearance. Explicitly noisy: mergers, voluntary delistings and other benign corporate actions are not distinguished from distress-driven disappearance -- this project has no compliant corporate-actions source.

censoring_policy.unknown_trading_stop: A company whose trading stops (BHAVCOPY_DISAPPEARANCE fires) is never silently labelled negative for the primary outcome within any as_of window that extends past its last trade_date plus min_gap_days -- that window's primary-outcome label is RIGHT-CENSORED, not a confirmed negative, and must be excluded or explicitly flagged (not imputed as 0) in any evaluation that uses it.
censoring_policy.end_of_window_observation: An as_of whose 12-month forward window extends past the end of this project's real data coverage (currently 2026-10-30 for price_bars; per-source for CARE/IBBI/SEBI, see docs/phase-3/phase-3-report.md §2) is RIGHT-CENSORED for the same reason -- the absence of an observed trigger before data ends is not evidence of a true negative, since a real trigger could exist after the data's own coverage end and simply not yet be observed.

excluded_rating_agencies_reason: ICRA is BLOCKED (bot-mitigation challenge); CRISIL excluded by its own stated exclusion terms -- see docs/data/source-inventory.md. CARE is the only AVAILABLE agency as of this spec's freeze date.

universe_coverage_gaps.ibbi_coverage: Phase 3 §2.3/§3 broadened IBBI discovery from the 15-company SEED-track universe to every currently-listed company (via NSE's own equity master files), but NOT to companies already delisted before this spec's freeze date beyond the 15 known individually -- those remain unchecked (not confirmed-negative) for IBBI_CIRP_ADMISSION.
universe_coverage_gaps.rating_coverage: CARE rationale discovery (Phase 3 §2.2) was driven by the 15-company SEED-track universe, not the full currently-listed universe -- RATING_DOWNGRADE_D is only checked for those 15 companies as of this spec's freeze date.
